name: Smithing tables
note: Smithing tables upgrade (the base's damage and components kept) and trim (the addition's material in the recipe's or template's pattern) by the data packs' smithing recipes; each slot takes what some recipe takes there, quick moves route by them, taking the result uses one of each input; 24 steps give the same windows and components as both official servers
deviations: on 1.21.5 and later, trim materials come from the vanilla materials' items, not from the items' provides_trim_material component
